summary: A fiction excerpt (Book 10, part 54) in which Trish and Damian, driving a tiny two-seater, find their navigation has failed in what Trish calls a dead spot. Trish, acting as navigatrix, sends Damian onto the shoulder and hunts the glove compartment for a paper map, which Damian mocks. She finds an old-fashioned phone left behind by Damian's mother and reasons that it can reach a tower at long distance, so they can call for directions. The call to his mother reveals the grid is down for them too, and the scene is playful, with a running joke about their humor and the early history of their relationship.
one_line: Trish and Damian, stranded when the navigation grid fails, use an old phone left by Damian's mother to try to get directions.
key_facts: Trish tells Damian that they need to manually route themselves out of the dead spot and get back on the grid.
Trish identifies herself as the navigatrix and Damian as the pilot.
Damian asks what century Trish lives in and says his maps are with the sextant, sundial, leeches and obsidian sacrifice-knife.
Trish says every car has a couple maps that self-assemble from happy meal boxes.
Trish claims that driving on the shoulder is allowed when the routing goes down, citing the written-test manual she studied while helping her little cousin Leelee.
Trish finds an old-fashioned phone in the glove compartment, which Damian says his mom left behind a couple years ago.
Trish reasons that the phone can unmesh and talk straight to a tower at a long distance, so it works in dead spots.
Trish calls Damian's mother, introducing herself as Trish, Damian's friend.
Trish tells the mother that the grid is down, the car has no nav system, the dolby is out, and the Interstate is a parking-lot.

Trish and Damian discovered their ability to make each other laugh on their second date, when he farted while taking off his kilt and she swung the hem back to make it look like the pleats were ruffled by his gust.

entities.name: Trish
entities.role: Narrator's character who acts as navigatrix, finds the old phone, and calls Damian's mother

entities.name: Damian
entities.role: Driver and pilot who mocks the maps and pulls onto the shoulder

entities.name: Leelee
entities.role: Trish's little cousin, whom she helped study for the written test

entities.name: Damian's mom
entities.role: Owner of the old-fashioned phone left in the car, who is also affected by the grid outage
